put.description: Bearer-only administrator upload. Cookie authentication is not accepted, so this endpoint does not use antiforgery tokens. Exactly one multipart file field named file; maximum 5 MiB file and 6 MiB request.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Exact strong image ETag. Required when replacing or deleting an existing image; stale versions return 412, omitted versions return 428.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Only * is accepted, for create-only upload. Cannot be combined with If-Match.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
